title: Orikan Group Pty Ltd - Duncan Technologies Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Informal Merger Review Guidelines.
ACCC requested further information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (21 November 2024) was delayed.
ACCC received further information from the parties. Timeline recommenced.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Timeline suspended pending receipt of information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of ACCC's findings (13 March 2025) was delayed.
ACCC received further information from the parties. ACCC amended former provisional date for announcement of findings to 1 May 2025.
Timeline suspended pending receipt of information from the parties. Former provisional date for announcement of ACCC's findings (1 May 2025) was delayed.
ACCC received further information from the parties. ACCC amended former provisional date for announcement of findings to 22 May 2025.
ACCC discontinued its public review after Orikan advised that the proposed acquisition would not be proceeding.

body_sections.Summary: On 19 April 2024, Orikan Group Pty Ltd ( Orikan ) requested pre-assessment from the ACCC on its proposal to acquire 100% of issued capital of Duncan Technologies Pty Ltd ( Duncan ). Orikan is an unlisted company that provides end-to-end parking solutions in Australia, New Zealand and other countries. This includes the supply of parking software, payment technologies and infringement products to state governments and local councils, educational institutions, and commercial customers. Duncan provides parking solutions in Australia and other countries, including supply and maintenance of parking meters, enforcement software and processing of infringements to government municipalities and private operators. Duncan also resells payment apps, sensors, number plate recognition hardware and software and camera automated enforcement software of third parties.
